title: Clearer Nano Banana refusals
summary:
Nano Banana refusals got more useful, and Hacktoberfest contributors got clearer rules of the road.

When Nano Banana returns no image, the image API now reports Gemini’s explanation when available, or the candidate’s refusal reason instead of a generic Vertex AI error.

New guidelines explain which October PRs count toward the event badge and what qualifies for the Pollinations Contributor badge. A Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct sets out community standards.
